Class TriMesh

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a mutable triangle mesh stored as a flat vertex buffer.

public sealed class TriMesh : IEquatable<TriMesh>

Remarks

Every 3 consecutive vertices form one triangle. This type is optimized for pooled/buffer-oriented workflows, while still providing helpers for copying, transforming, hashing, drawing, and conversion to Triangulation.

Removes any trailing vertices that do not form a complete triangle.

Remarks

GetCentroid()

Calculates the centroid of the entire mesh.

public Vector2 GetCentroid()

Returns

Vector2

The area-weighted centroid when the mesh contains at least one non-degenerate triangle; otherwise the arithmetic mean of all stored vertices, or (0,0) when the mesh is empty.

Parameters

angleRad float

The target rotation angle in radians.

pivot Vector2

The pivot point about which to rotate.

Remarks

The current orientation is determined by the first non-zero vertex direction from the pivot. If all vertices coincide with the pivot, the mesh is left unchanged.
